text:
sam.partnerships: Quick sync — coordinating vendor roadmap overlap (H200 / MI300 / Gaudi) for marketplace + SI integrations. Need to nail embargo windows and SI early access timeline. I created a living sheet: https://rwd.red/marketplace-hw-sync

javier.hw: @sam.partnerships noted. NVIDIA H200 internal GA likely 2026-06-15 (vendor tentative). B200 still TBD. AMD MI300 OEM drop target 2026-05-10. Will confirm exact driver/OS bundle drop dates.

priya.product: For marketplace we need ~4w certification + 2w SI validation. Proposal: public lift = vendor GA + 3w. Can we map that to vendor dates?

liam.mktg: Marketing needs 1w heads-up to prep blog + assets. If SI signoff happens early, could compress to 2w total? :thinking_face:

yuki.solutions: SI partners want early access images at vendor driver drop + 1w. They also need a minimal test plan (smoke/perf/quant) to commit resources.

ops-bot: calendar: Add events `Vendor GA`, `Early Access`, `Marketplace QA`, `Public Launch` to shared calendar.

sam.partnerships: Action items: 1) @javier.hw confirm driver & image drop dates by EOD Fri. 2) @yuki.solutions draft minimal smoke/perf checklist. 3) @priya.product write provisional embargo policy in the sheet. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue. Sheet tabs: dates / si-requests / embargo-rules / marketing.

javier.hw: Confirming. Also Gaudi partner asked for region-first sequencing (EMEA before NA). Potentially staggered marketplace windows — flagging.

priya.product: Draft embargo doc uploaded to the sheet (tab: embargo-rules). TL;DR: vendor GA -> +14d internal QA -> +7d SI validation -> public. Exceptions require PM + Legal.

liam.mktg: Noted re: EMEA-first. We'll prepare phased comms and segmented landing pages. @sam.partnerships pls cc product on partner announcement draft.

yuki.solutions: Uploaded minimal test checklist (tab: si-requests). Items: kernel/driver sanity, sample inference job, latency baseline, quantization smoke. @javier.hw please confirm infra reqs.

deploy-bot: New spreadsheet created by sam.partnerships: https://rwd.red/marketplace-hw-sync (internal link)

sam.partnerships: Proposed follow-up: 30m sync Friday 10:00 PT to lock dates. If vendor dates slip we'll run marketplace-only beta for a subset of customers. :thumbsup:

javier.hw: +1 for Fri. FYI vendor asked to avoid public announcement until their partner webinar finishes — short embargo request.

priya.product: Will add 'announce after partner webinar' checkbox in sheet.

liam.mktg: 👍

sam.partnerships: Thanks all. I'll send calendar invite and a short pre-read. If anyone can't make Fri, drop availability in the sheet.
